page_title: FUL 5-0 NOT | Fulham v Nottingham Forest 06/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A snap shot from distance by Harry Wilson (Fulham) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90+4' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

90+4' Fode Ballo-Toure (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+3' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
90+2' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends the corner into the box, but Odysseas Vlachodimos intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+1' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) sprays a pass out to Carlos Vinicius, but he can't beat his man inside the box. Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.
90+1' A dangerous looking corner kick from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' Fode Ballo-Toure (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
89' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
86' 5 - 0 Goal - 5:0! Andreas Pereira tees up Tom Cairney (Fulham) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Odysseas Vlachodimos.
85' A long pass, executed by Calvin Bassey (Fulham), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
83' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
82' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

82' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Bernd Leno pulls off a brilliant save.
81' The ball is behind the touchline and Nottingham will take a throw-in.
79' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Joao Palhinha and he is replaced by Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raul Jimenez departs the field of play to be replaced by Carlos Vinicius (Fulham).
79' Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
78' Harry Wilson (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was quite harsh and Joshua Smith didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) will replace Felipe.
75' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) replaces Alex Iwobi.
75' That's the end of the game for Antonee Robinson, who is replaced by Fode Ballo-Toure (Fulham).

74' 4 - 0 Goal! Harry Wilson displays great vision and sends a pass to Alex Iwobi (Fulham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 4:0.
72' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Morgan Gibbs-White collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
69' A cross is whipped into the box by Ola Aina (Nottingham) and Chris Wood controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
65' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) jumps into a tackle and Joshua Smith signals a foul.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Harry Wilson (Fulham) for Willian.
63' Willian (Fulham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
61' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) switches the play to Willian and their attacking move continues.
58' Steven Cooper decides to make a substitution. Callum Hudson-Odoi will be replaced by Danilo (Nottingham).
58' Substitution. Chris Wood (Nottingham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Divock Origi walks off.
54' 3 - 0 Goal! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) scores a Zlatan Ibrahimovic-esque back-heel goal. What a finish that is! 3:0.
54' Willian links up with Raul Jimenez (Fulham), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
53' Raul Jimenez receives a sweet cross inside the box from Alex Iwobi (Fulham), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
51' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes a short free kick.
50' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
48' A pass by Andreas Pereira (Fulham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
48' The ball has crossed the sideline. Nottingham are taking a throw-in.
46' The second half has just started.
46' The game is over for Nicolas Dominguez. Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) comes on for the second half.
46' Steven Cooper makes a switch. Ryan Yates is coming on in place of Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) at the start of the second period.
45+5' Joshua Smith has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45+3' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
45+3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45+2' The ball is out of play. Fulham will have a throw-in.
45+1' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:0.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
42' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) serves up a nice cross, but Bernd Leno punches the ball away.
42' Tom Cairney (Fulham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Joshua Smith blows for a foul.
40' The resulting corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
39' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips the ball into the box and Alex Iwobi takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Some patient build-up play from Fulham as they look to unlock the defence.
36' Odysseas Vlachodimos (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Andreas Pereira tees up Raul Jimenez (Fulham) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top right corner and past Odysseas Vlachodimos.
33' Murillo (Nottingham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
30' 1 - 0 Alex Iwobi (Fulham) meets a perfect cross from Willian deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
28' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
26' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) unleashed a brilliant free kick from the edge of the box and hits the left post of the goal.
25' Joshua Smith blows the whistle, Felipe (Nottingham) is penalised for a foul. Fulham are awarded a free kick.
22' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) tries to find Timothy Castagne, but he puts too much power on the pass.

21' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Odysseas Vlachodimos leaps like a salmon to deny him.
20' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Andreas Pereira latches onto his pass.
19' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
17' Divock Origi (Nottingham) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post.
17' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Odysseas Vlachodimos comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Joshua Smith blows his whistle for a foul.
14' That's unlucky! Andreas Pereira (Fulham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
12' The free kick is delivered by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
10' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
10' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
9' Felipe (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Joshua Smith blows his whistle for an infringement.
9' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
6' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' Joshua Smith blows his whistle for a foul after Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) hacks down one of his opponents.
3' The corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared away by the defence.
3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Fulham win a corner.
2' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) brings an opponent down and Joshua Smith interrupts the game.
1' The match has just started.
